## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Oct 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Olga Shinalskaja_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "Ads. They are so desperate for us to pay. Maybe they should invest that energy into making a good app instead. This one is buggy and has been as far back as I remember."
            2. _Jimmy Willis_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "I installed this app a while ago for the ad free notes. then it would give us pop-up messages to promote themselves to upgrade and pay. I would just select no and close out of it. no big deal. but now there are ads that don't let you even use the app until they're done and you can't close out of them right away. This app is now unusable. I have deleted all my notes and uninstalled."
            3. _Matt Hilden_, Sep 30, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a daily Evernote user for years. The app gets updated way too frequently, and the stability from update to update has been shaky for some time now. the app feels slow and unstable. I wonder if the core features that I use will work today? Now I get notified that they are doubling the price, citing the "features" that they have been adding as justification. $250/year for this? I'm moving on to Obsidian. Bye bye, Evernote. It used to be fun. One star because export was easy."
<!--/ir-theme-->
